verses.en: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.pt: Sendo, pois, Davi já velho e farto de dias, fez a Salomão seu filho rei sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now David was old and full of days; and he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

verses.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.pt: E juntando a todos os principais de Israel, e a os sacerdotes e levitas,
verses.en_web: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.en_bbe: And he got together all the chiefs of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

verses.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.pt: Foram contados os levitas de trinta anos acima; e foi o número deles por suas cabeças, contados um a um, trinta e oito mil.
verses.en_web: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.en_bbe: And the Levites, all those of thirty years old and over, were numbered; and the number of them, by heads, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

verses.en: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:
verses.pt: Destes, vinte e quatro mil para dar pressa à obra da casa do SENHOR; e governadores e juízes, seis mil;
verses.en_web: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,
verses.en_bbe: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to be overseers of the work of the house of the Lord, and six thousand were judges and men of authority;

verses.en: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
verses.pt: Ademais quatro mil porteiros; e quatro mil para louvar a o SENHOR, disse Davi, com os instrumentos que fiz para render louvores.
verses.en_web: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
verses.en_bbe: Four thousand were door-keepers; and four thousand gave praise to the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, for giving praise.

verses.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.pt: E repartiu-os Davi em ordens conforme a os filhos de Levi, Gérson e Coate e Merari.
verses.en_web: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.en_bbe: And David put them into divisions under the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.en: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Gérson: Ladã, e Simei.
verses.en_web: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
verses.en_bbe: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

verses.en: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Ladã, três: Jeiel o primeiro, depois Zetã e Joel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham and Joel, three.

verses.en: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Simei, três: Selomote, Haziel, e Harã. Estes foram os príncipes das famílias de Ladã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth and Haziel and Haran, three; these were the heads of the families of Ladan.

verses.en: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Simei: Jaate, Zina, Jeus, e Berias. Estes quatro foram os filhos de Simei.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zizah and Jeush and Beriah; these four were the sons of Shimei.

verses.en: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.
verses.pt: Jaate era o primeiro, Zina o segundo; mas Jeus e Berias não multiplicaram em filhos, por o qual foram contados por uma família.
verses.en_web: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
verses.en_bbe: Jahath was the chief and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah had only a small number of sons, so they were grouped together as one family.

verses.en: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel, eles quatro.
verses.en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

verses.en: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão e Moisés. E Arão foi apartado para ser dedicado às mais santas coisas, ele e seus filhos para sempre, para que queimassem perfumes diante do SENHOR, e lhe ministrassem, e bendisessem em seu nome, para sempre.
verses.en_web: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons, forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name, forever.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was made separate and holy, he and his sons for ever, for the care of the most holy things and the burning of offerings before the Lord, to do his work and give blessings in his name for ever.

verses.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Moisés, homem de Deus, foram contados na tribo de Levi.
verses.en_web: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Moses, the man of God, were put into the list of the tribe of Levi.

verses.en: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Moisés foram Gérson e Eliézer.
verses.en_web: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.en: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
verses.pt: Filho de Gérson foi Sebuel o primeiro.
verses.en_web: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the first.

verses.en: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.pt: E filho de Eliézer foi Reabias o primeiro. E Eliézer não teve outros filhos; mas os filhos de Reabias foram muitos.
verses.en_web: The sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the first; and Eliezer had no other sons, but Rehabiah had a great number.

verses.en: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.pt: Filho de Izar foi Selomite o primeiro.
verses.en_web: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the first.

verses.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Hebrom: Jería o primeiro, Amarias o segundo, Jaaziel o terceiro, e Jecameão o quarto.
verses.en_web: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Uziel: Mica o primeiro, e Issias o segundo.
verses.en_web: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first, and Isshiah the second.

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi. Os filhos de Mali: Eleazar e Quis.
verses.en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

verses.en: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
verses.pt: E morreu Eleazar sem filhos, mas teve filhas; e os filhos de Quis, seus irmãos, as tomaram por mulheres.
verses.en_web: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brothers the sons of Kish took them as wives.
verses.en_bbe: And at his death Eleazar had no sons, but only daughters, and their relations, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

verses.en: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Musi: Mali, Éder e Jeremote, eles três.
verses.en_web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Mushi: Mahli and Eder and Jeremoth, three.

verses.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Levi nas famílias de seus pais, cabeceiras de famílias em suas linhagens, contados por seus nomes, por suas cabeças, os quais faziam obra no ministério da casa do SENHOR, de vinte anos acima.
verses.en_web: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.en_bbe: These were the sons of Levi, grouped by families, the heads of the families of those who were numbered by name, by heads, all those of twenty years old and over who did the work of the house of the Lord.

verses.en: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.pt: Porque Davi disse: o SENHOR Deus de Israel há dado repouso a seu povo Israel, e o habitar em Jerusalém para sempre.
verses.en_web: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
verses.en_bbe: For David said, The Lord, the God of Israel, has given his people rest, and he has made his resting-place in Jerusalem for ever;

verses.en: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.pt: E também os levitas não levarão mais o tabernáculo, e todos seus vasos para seu ministério.
verses.en_web: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
verses.en_bbe: And from now, there will be no need for the House of the Lord, and the vessels used in it, to be moved about by the Levites.

verses.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.pt: Assim que, conforme as últimas palavras de Davi, foi a contagem dos filhos de Levi de vinte anos acima.
verses.en_web: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.en_bbe: So among the last acts of David was the numbering of the sons of Levi, from twenty years old and over.

verses.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.pt: E estavam sob a mão dos filhos de Arão, para ministrar na casa do SENHOR, nos átrios e nas câmaras, e na purificação de toda coisa santificada, e na demais obra do ministério da casa de Deus;
verses.en_web: For their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house, in the courts, and in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;
verses.en_bbe: Their place was by the side of the sons of Aaron in all the work of the house of the Lord, in the open spaces and in the rooms, in the making clean of all the holy things, in doing all the work of the house of the Lord,

verses.en: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.pt: Assim para os pães da proposição, e para a flor da farinha para o sacrifício, e para os pães sem levedura, e para as coisas postas em panelas, e para o tostado, e para toda medida e conta;
verses.en_web: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;
verses.en_bbe: The holy bread was in their care, and the crushed grain for the meal offering, of unleavened cakes or meal cooked over the fire or in water; they had control of all sorts of weights and measures;

verses.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
verses.pt: E para que assistissem cada manhã todos os dias a confessar e louvar a o SENHOR, e assim à tarde;
verses.en_web: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;
verses.en_bbe: They had to take their places every morning to give praise and make melody to the Lord, and in the same way at evening;

verses.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
verses.pt: E para oferecer todos os holocaustos a o SENHOR os sábados, novas luas, e solenidades, por a conta e forma que tinham, continuamente diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;
verses.en_bbe: At every offering of burned offerings to the Lord, on Sabbaths, and at the new moons, and on the regular feasts, in the number ordered by the law, at all times before the Lord;

verses.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: E para que tivessem a guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho, e a guarda do santuário, e as ordens dos filhos de Arão seus irmãos, no ministério da casa do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers, for the service of Yahweh’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And they had the care of the Tent of meeting and the holy place, under the direction of the sons of Aaron their brothers, for the work of the house of the Lord.
